HOW LEARNING WORKS

Learn step by step, one lesson at a time.

01

Learn the concept

Read focused lessons with clear explanations, examples and code where relevant. No login needed.

02

Put it into practice

Work through the lesson's practice resource. Follow the provider's instructions; practice completion is self-reported.

03

Check your understanding

Take a self-check to confirm what you learned. Your progress is saved in this browser, without a login or email.

Progress is a personal learning record—not a verified certificate or accreditation. Clearing browser data removes it; download a backup in Device settings. Code examples are read-only; external practice providers may require their own account.
